# Apex Flow 3D Scraper

> Convert accessible public web pages, PDF and DOCX documents into clean Markdown. Hosted API with prepaid credits, or open-source self-hosting. Built by Apex Flow Labs. Engine version 0.2.0; hosted launch 6 November 2026.

## What it does
- Converts pages to Markdown with headings, GFM tables, fenced code with language, absolute links; removes navigation, cookie banners and hidden elements.
- Renders JavaScript pages in an isolated Brave browser, with screenshots on request.
- Reads PDF, DOCX, RSS/Atom feeds and JSON.
- Data packages (hosted, 1 credit an answer): POST /v1/packages/zillow {region, metric: home_values|rents, months} returns a US metro's typical home value or rent, one-year change and monthly series from Zillow Research public data; POST /v1/packages/npr {topic, limit} returns NPR headlines with links. GET /v1/packages lists them. MCP tools: zillow_market, npr_news. Metro-level data only, not individual listings.
- Maps sites (robots.txt, nested and gzip sitemaps), crawls with durable jobs, change tracking with diffs.
- Owned full-text search (SQLite FTS5, BM25) over everything scraped.
- JSON-Schema extraction using DeepSeek first, OpenRouter second.
- MCP tools for agents: fetch, map, crawl, search, compare.
- Crawls and maps obey robots.txt; all requests obey Crawl-delay. A page requested by exact address is read even where robots.txt disallows it (receipt.robots_txt is then disallowed_read_on_request). A refused live read returns the Internet Archive copy by default, labelled; send "fallback":"none" for the error instead.
- Fetches public addresses only.

## Measured results (30 public URLs, 94 hand-checked reference checks, 5 Nov 2026)
- 26 of 30 URLs fetched; 92 of 94 Markdown fidelity checks passed (97.9%).
- Median 1,454 ms per URL; median process memory 56.4 MB.
- Versus Firecrawl (free keyless tier, same checks, hand-scored) on 24 URLs with references: 91/93 vs 85/93; we score higher on 6 pages, tie on 18, lower on 0. Firecrawl returned content for all 30 URLs; we returned 26 (two blocked by robots.txt that we obey, two by bot walls).

## Hosted service and limits
- Hosted API: https://webscraper.apexflowlabs.com/v1. OpenAPI 3.1: https://webscraper.apexflowlabs.com/openapi.json. Human enrollment: https://webscraper.apexflowlabs.com/trial.html. Free trial: 1,000 credits once, subject to network and daily capacity. Project Pass: $5 once for 35,000 credits valid for 30 days. Monthly plans: $15 for 110,000; $79 for 850,000; $299 for 3,750,000 credits. Plain pages cost 1, rendered pages 3, AI extraction 25 more. No automatic overages.
- Hosted: page scraping, JavaScript rendering, CSS field extraction, parallel batches of up to 10 URLs (pages at once: 2 on the trial, 6 on Pass and Starter, 12 on Growth, 20 on Scale), change tracking, sitemap mapping, and account-scoped search over your latest scraped URLs (100 on the trial, 1,000 on paid plans). A nonempty map costs 1 credit; saved-page search costs no credits.
- Hosted responses: 256 KiB per response. Longer documents are returned in consecutive parts (pagination.next_page; request with page). Concurrent page scrapes per account: 2 on the trial, 6 on Pass and Starter, 12 on Growth, 20 on Scale. Shared service limits: twenty active page scrapes and two simultaneous browser renders. Source crawl delays apply. Attempts, including failures, are capped at twice the plan's credits per period. Failed scrapes return reserved credits.
- AI extraction on paid plans: add extract {schema, prompt} to a scrape for 150 extra credits; result.extracted holds data, valid and errors. CSS recipes are free on every plan. Documentation: https://webscraper.apexflowlabs.com/docs.html.

## Crawl a site
- POST /v1/crawl {url, limit} starts a background crawl of one site's own pages and returns an id. Page limits: 10 trial, 100 Pass and Starter, 500 Growth, 1,000 Scale. GET /v1/crawl/{id}?offset=N returns status and pages; follow next_offset until null. Each page costs 1 or 3 credits; failed pages are free. MCP: crawl_site then crawl_status.
- Python client: rainbo_scrape.hosted_client.Apex. Node client: sdk/node/hosted.mjs in the repository.

## For agents: change tracking, errors and usage
- Change tracking: every scrape response includes change.status (new, unchanged or changed) compared with the copy this account read last. Add "diff" to outputs to receive only the changed lines and the source receipt, without the page body. MCP tool: check_changes(urls).
- Errors are JSON with error, a stable code (invalid_key, insufficient_credits, inactive_plan, rate_limited, invalid_request, timeout, source_failed) and retryable. A 402 includes credits_left and buy_url; show buy_url to the user. A 429 includes retry_after seconds. MCP tool errors carry the same fields.
- Every response carries X-Credits-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining and X-Request-Id. GET /v1/usage returns plan, limits, renewal date and 14 days of daily usage.

- Context budgets: every scrape reply includes estimated_tokens. Set max_tokens (200-60000) to receive a page in consecutive parts that each fit the budget; follow pagination.next_page with page.
- Archive fallback: when a live read fails because the site refused, errored, disallowed robots or removed the page, the error includes a hint. Retry with "fallback":"archive" (MCP: archive_fallback=true) to get the latest Internet Archive copy. result.archive states captured, snapshot_url and reason; treat the content as possibly out of date and tell the user its capture time.

## Not claimed
- No CAPTCHA solving or bot-wall evasion; zillow.com and glassdoor.com block live reads. The opt-in archive fallback returns a dated Internet Archive copy where one exists.
- Search covers sites you have indexed, not the whole web.
- We do not claim universal competitor superiority, the lowest price for every workload, or guaranteed availability on every source.

## Agent setup
Official MCP Registry entry: https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0.1/servers/io.github.Apexflowlabsllc%2Fapex-flow-web-scraper/versions/latest
Set up Codex CLI, Claude Code or VS Code: https://webscraper.apexflowlabs.com/docs.html#agents
Remote MCP: https://webscraper.apexflowlabs.com/v1/mcp (Streamable HTTP, Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY). Connect a stdio MCP client to the hosted API: https://webscraper.apexflowlabs.com/docs.html#agents. Eight tools: scrape_page, scrape_batch, check_changes, map_site, crawl_site, crawl_status, search_saved and credit_balance. Enrollment requires a human.

## Usage
Python: `from rainbo_scrape import scrape; scrape("https://example.com").markdown`
CLI: `rainbo-scrape fetch https://example.com`

For a smaller REST or MCP scrape response, select outputs such as ["markdown"] or ["data", "evidence"]. Source receipts and validation warnings are retained when available.
